description: Search ICD-10 PL diagnoses, ICD-9 PL procedures, JGP groups and, when asked, pre-released ICD-11 PL by code or Polish words (diacritics optional). Each hit has its code, title, path and JGP group count; JGP groups are always searched in today's catalog. Open a hit with get_code or get_jgp_group; walk a hierarchy with browse_codes.

query.description: A code or Polish words, e.g. J18.9 or zapalenie płuc.

service_date.description: Day of care, YYYY-MM-DD; picks the release in force. Default today in Poland.

systems.description: Dictionaries to search; add icd11-pl only when asked.

name: search_codes
title: Search codes
